visual: GRID hook: 2x2 real Paris / Milan / London fall street-style photos (one on a suitcase) with the centred serif title. Creator inset top-left from frame one.
line: Going to Europe this fall? Don't check a bag for Paris, Milan and London.

visual: Hard cut to OUR bag: the Light Chocolate Weekender sitting on top of a rolling suitcase beside her, Paris street, trench.
Her hands lifting the closed bag into the overhead bin, flap down, straps hooked.
line: and it goes in the overhead bin.

visual: Closed bag on the hotel luggage rack, three-quarter, straps hooked, key bell hanging. Hold clean on the name.
line: This is the Eleanor Weekender from Velantra.

visual: Paris crosswalk, long coat, coffee, the Weekender carried by the handles at her side.
line: Paris is where you pack less, pieces that work together,

visual: Open and packed on the hotel bed: knit, rolled shirt and pouch on the caramel leather lining, flap folded back behind the mouth.
line: so three days of clothes fit in here,

visual: Open and empty on the bench: the one-piece flap leaning back with its inner face and oval plate, caramel interior and slip pocket, post and staples on the plain front band.
line: and the flap folds all the way back so I can see everything.

visual: Milan hotel doorway, leather jacket, the Weekender over her forearm.
line: Milan is where it gets polished and intentional.

visual: Hand strokes the cognac leather over the canvas.
line: Full grain leather over woven canvas,

visual: Macro on the marble console: knurled brass post through the oval plate's keyhole, strap plate hooked over the staple. Nothing printed on it.
line: real brass hardware, no logo anywhere,

visual: Standing on its own on the hotel floor, empty, still square.
line: and it keeps its shape packed full or barely at all.

visual: London street, houndstooth blazer, tall boots, the Weekender in hand.
line: London is where you walk all day and it's four seasons in one day,

visual: Her hand pushes a knit down into the open bag on the desk, caramel interior and folded-back flap visible, coat on the chair.
line: so the knitwear and the coat come too, and it still keeps its shape.

visual: Bag riding on the carry-on through the terminal (library).
line: I've dragged mine through three airports and it still looks new.

visual: Four-up colorway card; the Black tile is labelled pre-order, ships mid September.
line: It comes in four colors, and the black one is a pre-order that ships mid September.

visual: LIVE PDP screen recording, continuous: $209.99 struck to $159.99, four swatches, Add to Cart. The ad ends here.
line: They're running a sale on it right now and the colors go fast, so grab it before the trip.

line: So tell me, Paris, Milan or London. Which one are you packing for? I left the link below.
